condition: upload_ad_image image_url must not trigger a request to a literal loopback/private address or prohibited URL scheme
prerequisites: HTTP tool caller can supply image_url and reach the image fetch before downstream Meta API success; a literal private/loopback destination is available to the server.
The label excludes DNS rebinding, hostname races, and whole-network egress-policy completeness.
safe: A public HTTP(S) literal such as https://8.8.8.8/image.jpg passes the relevant URL guard; accepting a public literal is not the labeled SSRF condition
review: upload_ad_image forwards image_url into download helpers. The patch validates scheme/address before downloads and applies an HTTP request hook to redirects. Literal-address rejection is enforced at the relevant fetch flow. No live service or DNS-rebinding experiment was performed.
safe_prerequisites: The fetch URL is an ordinary public IPv4 HTTP(S) literal; the control concerns URL-policy acceptance, not successful external service response or downstream Meta authentication.
